purpose: Read an operator-supplied map-local Y3 directory and fail closed until the minimum construction roots are present. This package never creates, edits, imports, or deploys Y3 assets.

y3_lualib_root.verification_scope: structural root only; actual API names and signatures still require source/reference verification before Lua is written

ui_root.verification_scope: root existence only; no UI node tree, JSON, or Lua is created or validated

object_interface_identifier.accepted_format: lowercase dotted interface name, for example object-editor.adapter
object_interface_identifier.semantic_boundary: This is an opaque construction-interface label, never a Y3 unit, ability, item, resource, or production object key.

failure_closed_conditions: TargetMapRoot is absent or not a directory.
The map-local script root is absent.
The script/y3 root or either required structural directory is absent.
The UI root is absent, not a directory, or lies outside TargetMapRoot.
A supplied object-interface identifier is blank or is not a lowercase dotted interface name.
non_goals: Create maps, map roots, terrain, points, paths, areas, units, abilities, buffs, items, editor_table JSON, UI nodes, UI JSON, Lua modules, or object keys.
Claim editor readback, Y3 API compatibility, object-interface availability, persistent progress, authority services, network transport, or multiplayer verification.
Replace the separate P0 absolute-combat calibration gate or the TianTing authority contracts.

current_workspace_fixture.reason: The repository is an offline design and preconstruction workspace; it has no map-local script/y3 or ui root.

synthetic_fixture.purpose: Proves the structural gate and its reporting only; it is not a real Y3 map or editor artifact.

acceptance: The current repository root is explicitly rejected as a missing map-local script root.
A synthetic directory tree with script/y3/meta, script/y3/game, and ui passes only structural preflight.
Missing y3 structure, missing UI root, an out-of-root UI path, and malformed optional object-interface identifiers fail closed.
A structural pass still reports production_gate=closed and editor/API/object readback as unresolved.
